title: Create a character identity board in Midjourney using a consistent “full body…
content: Create a character identity board in Midjourney using a consistent “full body portrait” prompt (e.g., young Japanese female, anime style, highly detailed, standing pose, clean background, studio lighting, sharp focus) and reuse the same prompt to keep character identity consistent for Seedance 2.0 video generation.
tips: Create a character identity board in Midjourney using a consistent “full body portrait” prompt (e.g., young Japanese female, anime style, highly detailed, standing pose, clean background, studio lighting, sharp focus) and reuse the same prompt to keep character identity consistent for Seedance 2.0 video generation.

es.content:
Crea un tablero de identidad de personaje en Midjourney utilizando un "prompt de retrato de cuerpo completo" consistente (por ejemplo, joven japonesa, estilo anime, altamente detallado, pose de pie, fondo limpio, iluminación de estudio, enfoque nítido) y reutiliza el mismo prompt para mantener la identidad del personaje consistente para la generación de video de Seedance 2.0.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Hilo 1] Midjourney prompt: Full body portrait of a young Japanese female character, stylish and attractive, anime style, highly detailed, standing pose, fashionable modern outfit, clean background, studio lighting, sharp focus

identidad del personaje mismo prompt que antes, para video puedes verlo pronto.
